Market today: The mood is cautious, with clear warnings of more pain ahead for tech stocks. The real driver is a combination of tech-specific headwinds and broader debt market concerns, directly impacting your concentrated portfolio.

Your holdings: Your leveraged ETFs, SOXL (-58.32%), MUU (-34.55%), and SPAL (-37.46%), are bleeding heavily and need immediate attention. Remember, margin amplifies these drops. SMCI (-27.92%) is also a significant concern.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the broader tech sector for further weakness, especially how debt market issues might spread. Also, monitor your existing stops, as many are now above current prices.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management and capital preservation, especially with your leveraged, losing tech positions.
plays: Trim SOXL, MUU, and SPAL to reduce exposure to leveraged ETFs. These are decaying and facing expected tech pain.
Re-evaluate stops on all "SELL" status positions, particularly SMCI and SNOW, as current prices are below listed stops.
No new buys today - hold and watch for clearer tech market signals before adding new positions.
